verses.text: I looked up and saw a man holding a measuring line.
I asked, “Where are you going?” He told me, “To measure Jerusalem and find out how wide and long it is.”
Then the angel speaking with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him.
The second angel told him, “Run and tell that young man: ‘Jerusalem will be an open city, full of people and livestock, without walls around it.
I myself,’ says the LORD, ‘will be a wall of fire around it, and I will be its glory inside.’”
“Come! Come! Flee from the northern land,” says the LORD, “because I scattered you to the four winds of heaven,” says the LORD.
“Come, Zion! Escape, you who live with Daughter Babylon.”
The LORD of Armies says: “For his glory, he sent me to the nations that plundered you. Whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye.
“Look, I will raise my hand against them, and their own servants will plunder them. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies sent me.
“Sing and celebrate, daughter of Zion! Look, I am coming, and I will live among you,” says the LORD.
“Many nations will join the LORD on that day. They will become my people, and I will live among you. Then you will know that the LORD of Armies sent me to you.
The LORD will claim Judah as his share in the holy land and choose Jerusalem again.
“Be quiet, everyone, before the LORD, because he has risen from his holy dwelling!”
